### Steps to reproduce using minimal config

- Install COC: https://github.com/neoclide/coc.nvim

- Create file `mini.vim` with:

```vim
set nocompatible                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
set runtimepath^=~/.local/share/nvim/plugged/coc.nvim    
filetype plugin indent on                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
syntax on                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
set hidden                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
function! Foobar()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
   let foo = system("bar")    
endfunction           
                     
set statusline+=%{Foobar()} 
set termguicolors
```

- Start neovim with command:

```
nvim -u mini.vim
```

- Type `:CocAction` or `:CocList`.

### Actual behaviour

Nvim 0.5.0 crashes :

> nvim: /home/travis/build/neovim/bot-ci/build/neovim/.deps/build/src/libuv/src/unix/stream.c:1400: uv_write2: Assertion `nbufs > 0' failed.

Doesn't happen with 0.4.3.
